documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Tech Mahindra Limited Has informed About Newspaper Advertisement Published Regarding The Notice Of Loss Of Share Certificates

analysis.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a strong financial performance for Q2 FY27 with revenues of $1.693 billion, marking 7.2% year-on-year growth in constant currency, and total deal wins of $1.023 billion. Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%, supported by volume growth and cost savings, and management reiterated its target of achieving a 15% EBIT margin for the full year FY27. The company is actively scaling its AI initiatives under TechM Helix and announced a 1:1 bonus share issue to mark its 40th anniversary. Tech Mahindra reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, registering consolidated revenue of ₹16,180 crores and a net profit after tax of ₹1,586 crores. The company declared an interim dividend of ₹15 per share and recommended a bonus equity share issue in the ratio of 1:1.

guidance.claim: The management reiterated its target to achieve a full-year FY27 EBIT margin of 15%.
guidance.quote: We reiterate that we remain on track to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects normal seasonality in the second half of the year.
The company anticipates a sequential revenue headwind in the manufacturing business in Q3.
guidance.quote: A sequential revenue headwind associated with the program is expected in Q3 as well, though to a much smaller extent.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.
guidance.quote: We reiterate our stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects to introduce AI revenue reporting starting with H2 FY27 disclosures.
guidance.quote: We expect to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of our H2 FY27 disclosures and continue it on an ongoing basis, refining the methodology as our portfolio and the markets mature.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of meeting or exceeding the goal of beating the peer average for the full financial year.
guidance.quote: On the whole, we feel we have a healthy order book for the remainder of the year, and barring any sort of unexpected and so far unforeseen macroeconomic developments, we remain confident that the growth momentum that we have set in the first quarter of the year will continue for the remainder of the year and that we will, you know, we will meet or exceed our goal of being ahead of peer average for the full financial year, as we already are in the first quarter of the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management continues to see opportunities across AI-led operational transformation, fiber and network modernization, and B2B platform modernization in Communications.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see opportunities across AI-led operational transformation, fiber and network modernization, and B2B platform modernization.

demand_outlook.claim: Cost optimization and consolidation initiatives continue to support a healthy pipeline in the Hi-Tech business.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, cost optimization and consolidation initiatives continue to support a healthy pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: Management continues to see opportunities to expand share within existing retail accounts and help clients strengthen infrastructure, data, and platforms for AI adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see opportunities to expand our share within existing accounts and help clients strengthen the infrastructure, data, and platforms needed for AI adoption.

demand_outlook.claim: Vendor consolidation and AI-led transformation remain key areas of opportunity in healthcare.
demand_outlook.quote: Our focus remains on expanding our presence across providers and life sciences, with vendor consolidation and AI-led transformation as key areas of opportunity.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a mixed macroeconomic environment for the retail, travel, and logistics vertical.
demand_outlook.quote: While the macroeconomic environment for this vertical remains mixed, our tailored offerings and focused client engagement approach are gaining traction and we remain positive about the direction of the business.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed continued volatility in client spending within the technology, media, and entertainment sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Technology, media, and entertainment declined 1.7% Q-o-Q on account of continued volatility in the client spend.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees challenges to demand in manual testing, traditional big data, standalone e-commerce, legacy CRM, and legacy infra admin.
demand_outlook.quote: Areas where we are seeing challenges to demand are sort of as you would expect in the manual testing area in your traditional big data area, in standalone e-commerce, in legacy CRM and legacy infra admin.

capex_expansion.claim: Tech Mahindra announced the acquisition of Canada-based Avant Techno Solutions, specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we also announced the acquisition of Avant Techno Solutions, a Canada-based firm specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 260 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points on a Q-o-Q basis and 260 basis points on a Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: The margin improvement was driven by strong volume growth and Project Fortius savings, partially offset by wage hikes.
margins_costs.quote: The margin improvement was driven by strong volume growth and Project Fortius savings, partially offset by the wage hikes.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margin was 14.8%, up by about 40 bps sequentially and approximately 260 bps year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: • EBIT Margin 14.8%, up ~40 bps QoQ, up ~260 bps YoY

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter were 14.4%, up 60 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 330 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were at US$238 million with EBIT percent at 14.4%, up 60 bps Q-o-Q and 330 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was driven by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.
margins_costs.quote: The margin expansion was led by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.

margins_costs.claim: Wage increases are expected to take effect starting in Q2 in a phased fashion.
margins_costs.quote: As far as the wage piece is concerned, we expect to be able to announce it effective Q2, obviously in a phased fashion which we will be announcing, to our employees in the days to come, so that will be effective, it'll start becoming effective Q2 in a phased fashion.

orders_capacity.claim: Total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to deal wins, our total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: New deal wins TCV reached $1,023 million, marking a 25.4% increase year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: • New deal wins TCV $1,023 mn, up 25.4% YoY

orders_capacity.claim: Deal wins exceeded $1 billion in each of the last four quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Deal wins exceeding $1+ billion in each of the last four quarters reflect the strength of our customer relationships and the trust we have built.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for shareholders.
capital_allocation.quote: As we mark this milestone, I'm also pleased to announce that our Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for our shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated US$135 million of free cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated US$135 million of free cash flow during the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share, reaffirming our commitment to the laid-out capital allocation policy of returning 85% and above of free cash flow back to shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of ₹15 per equity share of ₹5 face value.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 15/- per equity share of the face value of Rs. 5/- each (300%) for the Financial Year 2026-27.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a bonus equity share issue in the ratio of 1:1.
capital_allocation.quote: Issue of Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1, i.e. one (1) new fully paid-up Bonus Equity Share of Rs. 5/- each for every one (1) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 5/- each

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved increasing the authorized share capital from ₹924.3 crore to ₹1,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Increase in the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore, and consequent amendment to the existing Clause V(a) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed stood at 28.3% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 210 basis points.
capital_allocation.quote: Our return on capital employed stood at 28.3% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 210 basis points.

risks_headwinds.claim: The effective tax rate for the quarter came in at 29.9% due to a one-time tax adjustment related to prior periods tax matters.
risks_headwinds.quote: Effective tax rate for the quarter came in at 29.9% due to a one-time tax adjustment related to prior periods tax matters.

risks_headwinds.claim: Manufacturing revenue declined 3.9% sequentially against a higher prior-quarter base following the accelerated execution of a large European automotive program.
risks_headwinds.quote: Manufacturing revenue declined 3.9% sequentially against a higher prior-quarter base following the accelerated execution of a large European automotive program in the prior quarter, which I'd mentioned last time.

risks_headwinds.claim: A European auto business segment experienced an accelerated delivery one-off during the quarter that will create downward pressure in Q2.
risks_headwinds.quote: The one sort of headwind that we will have is the fact that we had a one-off in our European auto business in this quarter, which will show some signs of slowdown then in Q2.

management_commitments.claim: Completion of middleware for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer is expected by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Completion is expected by December 2026, with commercialization activities expected thereafter.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains on track to achieve the full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.
management_commitments.quote: We reiterate that we remain on track to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.

management_commitments.claim: The interim dividend will be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode.
management_commitments.quote: The Interim Dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode to those Members or their mandates

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue growth outpacing the peer average for the full financial year.
management_commitments.quote: On the whole, we feel we have a healthy order book for the remainder of the year, and barring any sort of unexpected and so far unforeseen macroeconomic developments, we remain confident that the growth momentum that we have set in the first quarter of the year will continue for the remainder of the year and that we will, you know, we will meet or exceed our goal of being ahead of peer average for the full financial year, as we already are in the first quarter of the financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Wage increases will become effective in a phased fashion starting in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: As far as the wage piece is concerned, we expect to be able to announce it effective Q2, obviously in a phased fashion which we will be announcing, to our employees in the days to come, so that will be effective, it'll start becoming effective Q2 in a phased fashion.
